title: Mates of exact unbounded derived squares on complex models
statement: Let C₁,C₂,C₃,C₄ be abelian categories with unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and assume K-injective resolutions in C₁ and C₃. Let L:C₂→C₁ ⊣ R and L′:C₄→C₃ ⊣ R′ be additive adjunctions with exact L,L′, and let G:C₂→C₄ and H:C₁→C₃ be additive exact functors. Given an ordinary square σ:G L′→L H and a derived square θ:D(G) D(L′)→D(L) D(H) normalized by σ on every homotopy complex model, its right mate for D(L)⊣RR and D(L′)⊣RR′, precomposed with D(G) of the unit R→RR, equals the localized ordinary right mate followed by the unit R′→RR′ and the inverse exact-functor localization factor for H. The precise factors are in the attached Lean statement.

source.place: Tags 09XP and 0F1E; coefficient normalization in step 11 of lem-pur-supported-product-localization, with exact derived mate calculation.

proof.text: Pass additive adjunctions to complexes and homotopy categories, where the mate formula is computed degreewise by unit, square, and counit. Expand the derived mate into the same three factors. Move the right-derived-functor unit through the square and use the unit and counit factorization equations for the derived adjunction. Apply the normalization of θ and naturality of the exact-functor localization factors. The resulting expression is the localization of the degreewise ordinary mate followed by the right derived unit.

theorem derivedExact_mateEquiv_app_fac (adj : L ⊣ R) (adj' : L' ⊣ R')
    (σ : TwoSquare G L L' G')
    (θ : TwoSquare G.mapDerivedCategory L.mapDerivedCategory L'.mapDerivedCategory
      G'.mapDerivedCategory)
    (hθ : ∀ N : HomotopyCategory C₂ (.up ℤ),
      θ.natTrans.app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj N) ≫
          G'.mapDerivedCategory.map (L.mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.hom.app N) ≫
          G'.mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.hom.app ((L.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj N) =
        L'.mapDerivedCategory.map (G.mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.hom.app N) ≫
          L'.mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.hom.app ((G.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj N) ≫
          DerivedCategory.Qh.map ((NatTrans.mapHomotopyCategory σ.natTrans (.up ℤ)).app N))
    (K : HomotopyCategory C₁ (.up ℤ)) :
    G.mapDerivedCategory.map (R.rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app K) ≫
        (mateEquiv adj.mapDerivedCategoryRightDerivedAdjunction
          adj'.mapDerivedCategoryRightDerivedAdjunction θ).natTrans.app
          (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj K) =
      G.mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.hom.app ((R.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj K) ≫
        DerivedCategory.Qh.map
          ((NatTrans.mapHomotopyCategory (mateEquiv adj adj' σ).natTrans (.up ℤ)).app K) ≫
        R'.rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app ((G'.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj K) ≫
        R'.rightDerivedFunctor.map (G'.mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.inv.app K)
